physical_case_nodes.required_validation: Public M00 15 raw cohort admitted and sealed, successive exact request times, full history when >8 projections, 12 exact independent categories, exact lineage, idempotent durable category output and standalone fresh read-only reopen. One fixed node, explicit no-parameterization; independent reviewer must judge internal assertion count.

physical_case_nodes.requirement: Exact typed original raw Decimal 1.01, same lawful provider/model/contract/unit/time/sequence and completed sealed history; verified arrival at range refusal; no category and no persisted result. Refusal reason observability remains design-review-open.

rule: The six-case ceiling is not permission to expand; do not conceal extra physical runs as parameterized oracles. Independence may accept a bounded explicit multi-assertion node only after inspecting collection and source-meaning equivalence. No product test has been run here.
